rationale: Source is a greenfield brainstorm with additive verbs (introducir, declarar, bind, delegar) and a table of existing primitives it claims to build on (PromptBuilder, KB loader, LLM Wiki/OKF, GraphIndex, ADR support, AgentRegistry/AgentCrew, AHP gates, OTEL). Research must verify each claimed primitive, find the closest existing bundle pattern (skills, agent YAML definitions), and surface integration points and gaps.

queries.intent: PromptBuilder API outline: which layers exist and whether an `identity` layer / replace-vs-stack semantics is already defined.
Identity capability spec: how a bot identity is declared today and whether it can be swapped per activation (persona.md as identity layer).
AgentRegistry API outline: discovery, registration, YAML agent definitions — where an expert bundle would hook in.
Neighbours of AgentRegistry (capabilities, routing, storage) to see what a registered entity already carries.
Agent definition YAML loading behaviour and BotConfig fields (closest existing declarative agent manifest).
ADR subsystem overview (knowledge/wiki/decisions): models, status lifecycle, toolkit — the 'soporte ADR' the source relies on.
GraphIndex L2 retrieval layer: policies and public entrypoints an expert's `mode: retrieval` source would call.
OKF bundle export contract (what an OKF bundle is, so Tier-1 `knowledge/` bundles can reuse it).
Bookstore catalog card contract: whether documents already carry id / sha256 / revision (DocumentKB equivalent).
AHP session-state spec: gate semantics (TTL fail-closed/fail-open) the stage gate would reuse.
Declarative dev-flow topology: how stages/nodes/gates are declared today (template for stage → lead/support binding).
Observability attribution ContextVars (agent/run/seat) — confirm per-expert OTEL needs no change.
Spawn-ephemeral-subagent tool index: the delegation tool `tools_deny: [spawn_agent]` must block.
Skills composite bundle (SKILL.md + assets, frontmatter, per-tenant shadowing) — the closest existing directory-bundle pattern to the expert bundle.

params.question: skills composite bundle SkillDefinition assets_dir frontmatter tenant shadowing

queries.intent: Long-term memory spec: is there any org/team/project-scoped memory file layout today (rules chain target).
CrewDefinition / crew agent roles: how AgentCrew is declared and whether role/lead/support exists.

params.question: CrewDefinition agents roles AgentCrew definition models sequential parallel

queries.intent: Existing hand-built domain agents (contracts, legal) — migration candidates named in the source.

params.question: contracts agent legal agent toolkit ContractsToolkit domain agent

queries.intent: Prior SDD art about agent skill systems / personas / experts to avoid duplicating an open spec.

params.question: agent persona expert knowledge tiers brainstorm spec
